standard_prerequisites.name: The Iritani integral-structure map, whose value on a line-bundle difference is expressed through the Gamma class and the Chern character
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the target expression for the proportionality check: the Gamma class of the blowup factors through the Gamma classes of the base and the exceptional directions, and the Chern character of O((-k+1)E)-O(-kE) contributes the exponential factor.

core_obligations: Transport the reflection condition through Proposition prop:tw=proj: under the state-space isomorphism, sigma(beta) must be proportional to the projective reflection vector Psi_q(O(k)) (proof lines 3244-3247).

Convert the projective reflection vector from the q- to the Q-variable using q^p = e^{pi i p} Q^{-p(n-1)} and the Gamma-function reflection identity, obtaining the explicit expression in the exceptional-divisor coordinates (proof lines 3248-3260).

Compute the Iritani image of the exceptional object O((-k+1)E)-O(-kE): factor the Gamma class of the blowup as Gamma(X) Gamma(1-e)^n Gamma(1+e), use the reflection identity for Gamma(1-e)Gamma(1+e) and the Chern character exponential, and simplify with Gamma(X) cup e = e (proof lines 3261-3280).
Observe the proportionality of the two expressions and conclude (proof line 3281).
proof_roadmap: Transport the reflection property to the projective side via the period comparison (proof lines 3244-3247).
Convert the projective reflection vector to blowup coordinates explicitly (proof lines 3248-3260).
Compute the Iritani image of the exceptional object through Gamma-factor identities and match (proof lines 3261-3281).
difficulty_reason: The statement identifies the classes in the exceptional-divisor state space whose periods are exchanged by the monodromy reflection gamma_k as exactly the Iritani images of the exceptional line-bundle differences (statement lines 3229-3241).
